title: Trapdoor Fans
description: Makes all trapdoor sounds a nice whirl, especially useful for when making moving fans out of trapdoors that bleed your ears.
body:
Makes all trapdoor sounds a nice whirl, especially useful for when making moving fans out of trapdoors that bleed your ears.
This was created for buildstone users who hate the sound of trapdoors when building big fans.
If you would like a pack that only affects iron trapdoors please check out my other pack
